text: The fixed full description row waits for eventDescription.html to finish loading before it accepts rich content. setDescription stores its arguments while the row is not connected; connectBrowser later flushes that data. The plain summary row has its own visibility event. This behavior is later than the original description-subview landing, where the expanded loader and call were still commented out. Existing summary/full/reset knowledge remains valid; the new detail is the asynchronous initialization and pending-data boundary. The HTML-conversion helper internals and runtime behavior were not independently tested.
title: Calendar description rows keep pending data until their rich document is ready
